subject: low acceptance rate of INLA MCMC method

messages.author: 71f80330c85d630c
messages.subject: low acceptance rate of INLA MCMC method
parts:
Hello,

I try to use the INLA MCMC method in the Bym example of volume 1. I
set inla.arg = "-m mcmc -N 500 -T 10 -S 1" as in
demo("Tokyo-compare"). But the acceptance rate is very low (around
0.03) and decreasing. I tried several -S values from 0.5 to 20 but the acceptance rate was still very low.

Is there a way to improve the acceptance rate?

The R code is below.

Thanks for helpful comments.
Best,

Florian
 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list=ls())
require(INLA)
data(Oral)
g <- system.file("demodata/germany.graph", package="INLA")
Oral.inla <- cbind(Oral,region.struct=Oral$region)

formula <- Y ~ -1 +
  f(region.struct,model="besag",graph=g,hyper=list(theta=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.5), initial=log(15)))) +
  f(region,model="iid",hyper=list(theta=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.01), initial=log(222))))

## INLA MCMC
## similar to demo("Tokyo-compare")
im.out <- inla(formula,family="poisson",data=Oral.inla,E=E,
  working.directory =  tempfile(), keep=TRUE, inla.arg = "-m mcmc -N 500 -T 10 -S 1", verbose=TRUE)

parts:
I realized that the MCMC sampler runs without problem in the older INLA version from 2009-01-01 on a Linux platform. The problem appears in
R version 3.0.0 (2013-04-03)
